title: "Leukocyte Telomere Length And Chronic Disease Burden In An Adult Community Sample A Cross-Sectional Study"
description: Telomere length is a biomarker of cellular aging and chronic disease risk, but its population-level correlates and disease-specific patterns remain unclear. This study examined telomere length associations and its contribution to disease prediction.
